rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Qushayri glosses the invocation as being by God and links it to the knowers’ illumination and lovers’ burning.
rows.anchor: فقلوب العارفين بالله أشراقها ، وقولب الوالهين بالله احتراقها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The knowers’ hearts are illuminated by God, while the ecstatic lovers’ hearts burn through God; the latter long for the sight of the Mighty.
rows.anchor: فقلوب العارفين بالله أشراقها ، وقولب الوالهين بالله احتراقها

rows.speaker: أصحاب الوصول
rows.claim: Those who have arrived say ‘by God’; among seekers, some consequently attain arrival.
rows.anchor: وأصحاب الوصول قالوا : بالله . . . فوصل من الطالبين من وصل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The opening disconnected letters serve as an oath affirming that this is a book sent down to the Prophet.
rows.anchor: أقسم بهذه الحروف : إنه لكتاب أنزل إليك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Quran takes people from ignorance’s darkness to knowledge’s light.
rows.anchor: من ظلمات الجهل إلى نور العلم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: It takes people from doubt to certainty.
rows.anchor: ومن ظلمات الشك إلى نور اليقين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: It takes people from worldly planning to the spaciousness of witnessing the divine decree.
rows.anchor: ومن ظلمات التدبير إلى فضاء شهود التقدير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: It takes people from religious innovation to following the revealed path.
rows.anchor: ومن ظلمات الابتداع إلى نور الاتباع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: It takes people from the ego’s claims to the heart’s gnoses.
rows.anchor: ومن ظلمات دعاوى النفس إلى نور معارف القلب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: It takes people from separation to unitive gathering.
rows.anchor: ومن ظلمات التفرقة إلى نور الجمع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This passage occurs by God’s permission, will, choice, and prior decree.
rows.anchor: بإذن ربهم - وبإرادته ومشيئته ، وسابق حكمه وقضائه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The path of the Mighty and Praiseworthy is the path of divine mercy, tawhid, and the signs of divine uniqueness.
rows.anchor: إلى صراط رحمته ، وهو نهج التوحيد وشواهد التفريد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God owns all that is in the heavens and earth; knowing Him leads to a praiseworthy return, while denying Him brings severe punishment rooted in ignorance of who He is.
rows.anchor: عرف الخلق أن الله هو الذي له ما في السموات وما في الأرض

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The deniers prefer scant worldly debris to the great blessings of the afterlife and seek to make religion crooked; their worldly lot is separation and their next-world lot is burning.
rows.anchor: هم الذين يؤثرون اليسير من حطام الدنيا على الخطير من نعم الآخرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God sends each messenger in the language of his people to make the proof against them more binding, though proof alone cannot help without success to follow the right path.
rows.anchor: إنما كان كذلك ليكون آكد في إلزام الحجة : وأنى ينفع ذلك إذا لم يوفقوا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those guided attain the care decreed beforehand, while the misguided fall into humiliation; no objection can be made to God’s acts.
rows.anchor: فأهل الهداية فازوا بالعناية السابقة ، وأصحاب الغواية وقعوا في ذل العداوة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses is told to bring his people from doubt to certainty and from the perplexity of ignorance to the vitality of knowledge.
rows.anchor: أخرج قومك بدعوتك من ظلمات شكهم إلى نور اليقين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Reminding people of God’s days means recalling the covenant and the afflictions previously lifted from them.
rows.anchor: وذكرهم بأيام الله ؛ ما سلف لهم من وقت الميثاق

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: Another reading takes God’s days as the spirits’ prior election and recognition of tawhid before entering bodily forms.
rows.anchor: ويقال ذكرهم بأيام الله وهي ما سبق لأرواحهم من الصفوة وتعريف التوحيد

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: A further reading makes God’s days the state of nonexistence, when God cared for people before they acted and they had no choice.
rows.anchor: ويقال ذكرهم بأيام الله وهي التي كان العبد فيها في كتم العدم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In that pre-action state, the elect did not strive, the moderate did not earn or neglect, and the self-wronger did no wrong, since the servant had no choice.
rows.anchor: فلا جهد للسابقين ، ولا عناء ولا ترك للمقتصدين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A patient person is content with God’s decree and stands firm when pleasant life brings ease.
rows.anchor: { صبار } : راض بحكمه واقف عند كون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The grateful person is veiled by witnessing blessings from becoming absorbed in the manifestation of the Real.
rows.anchor: { شكور } : محجوب بشهود النعم عن استغراقه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The patient and grateful each stand within their assigned limit and measure; God prevails in His affair, sanctified and mighty in holy majesty.
rows.anchor: هذا واقف مع صبره وهذا واقف مع شكره ، وكل ملزم بحده وقدره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: As Abraham asks for Mecca’s security, inwardly he asks that his heart be a safe abode containing nothing but God.
rows.anchor: كما سأل أن يجعل مكة بلدا آمنا طلب أن يجعل قلبه محلا آمنا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: An idol is anything worshipped apart from God.
rows.anchor: والصنم ما يعبد من دونه ، قال تعالى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse about taking one’s desire as a god (45:23) illustrates that an idol need not be a physical statue.
rows.anchor: والصنم ما يعبد من دونه ، قال تعالى : { أفرءيت من اتخذ إلهه هواه }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Each person’s idol is whatever distracts from God, including wealth, children, status, obedience, or worship.
rows.anchor: فصنم كل أحد ما يشغله عن الله تعالى من مال وولد وجاه

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: When building the House, Abraham asked God to free him from noticing his own self and deeds.
rows.anchor: ويقال إنه لما بنى البيت استعان بالله أن يجرده من ملاحظة نفسه وفعله

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: One account says Abraham moved between witnessing God’s favor and his own poverty: divine generosity prompted his prayer for his father, while self-poverty prompted his plea for protection from idols.
rows.anchor: فلما لقي من فضله وجوده قال قال من كمال بسطه

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: Another account says Abraham prayed for his father when witnessing God’s favor, mercy, and gentleness, and prayed against idolatry when he saw others’ condition.
rows.anchor: ويقال شاهد غيره فقال : { واجنبنى وبنى أن نعبد الأصنام }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The follower is of Abraham because he agrees with him and belongs to his religious community.
rows.anchor: { فإنه منى } : أي موافق لي ومن أهل ملتي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The one who disobeys Abraham opposes him and disobeys God.
rows.anchor: ومن عصانى خالفني وعصاك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: By saying God is forgiving and merciful, Abraham allusively asks Him to show mercy to those who disobeyed.
rows.anchor: طلب للرحمة بالإشارة ، أي فارحمهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abraham says ‘who disobeys me,’ rather than ‘who disobeys You,’ because he seeks mercy for those who violated his own right and meets them with mercy instead of vengeance.
rows.anchor: ولم يقل : من عصاك ، وإن كان من عصاه فقد عصى الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet’s prayer for his people is fuller in pardon because he directly asks God to forgive them, saying they do not know.
rows.anchor: ويقال إن قول نبينا في هذا الباب أتم في معنى العفو حيث قال

rows.speaker: النبي
rows.claim: The Prophet prayed, ‘O God, forgive my people, for they do not know.’
rows.anchor: حيث قال : ( اللهم اغفر لقومي فإنهم لا يعلمون )

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: Another reading says Abraham avoids making a definite request, maintaining the etiquette of supplication by stating God’s mercy instead.
rows.anchor: ويقال لم يجزم السؤال لأنه بدعاء الأدب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abraham’s statement that he settled his family there expresses truthful reliance on God and delegation to Him.
rows.anchor: أخبر عن صدق توكله وصدق تفويضه بقوله : { إني أسكنت }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He saw their care as lying in proximity to the House, rather than in worldly provision.
rows.anchor: وإنما رأى الرفق بهم في الجوار لا في المبار قال : { عند بيتك المحرم }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He settled them to establish God’s right, rather than to pursue their own interests.
rows.anchor: ثم قال : { ليقيموا الصلاة } : أي أسكنتم لإقامة حقك لطلب حظوظهم

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: Another reading says Abraham was content for his family to live under God’s care rather than under the shade of worldly blessings.
rows.anchor: ويقال اكتفى أن يكونوا في ظلال عنايته عن أن يكونوا في ظلال نعمته

words: فَٱجْعَلْ أَفْـِٔدَةًۭ مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ تَهْوِىٓ إِلَيْهِمْ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abraham asks that people’s hearts incline toward his family so they can devote themselves to worship, while God sustains them.
rows.anchor: أي ليشتغلوا بعبادتك ، وأقم قومي - ما بقوا - بكفايتك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Whoever fulfills God’s right is answered by God’s care for his people; hearts across land and sea become naturally inclined to love the House’s lineage, residents, and associates.
rows.anchor: فإن من قام بحق الله أقام الله بحقه قومه ، واستجاب الله دعاءه فيهم

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: The barren valley signifies a place where hearts do not attach to worldly others and minds and inner selves are not occupied by anything else.
rows.anchor: أسكنتهم بهذا الوادي حتى لا تتعلق بالأغيار قلوبهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The family are cast at God’s door, protected in His presence, and bound by His decree; cared for, they are honored, but rejected, they are utterly weak.
rows.anchor: فهم مطروحون ببابك ، مصونون بحضرتك ، مرتبطون بحكمك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Nothing is hidden from God; He knows Abraham’s inward and outward condition.
rows.anchor: استأثرت بعلم الغيب فلا يعزب عن علمك معلوم ، وحالي لا تخفى عليك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Knowing that God knows all brings rest from worldly intrusions, the translation of anxious thoughts, and distraction over events.
rows.anchor: ومن عرف هذه الجملة استراح من طوارق الأغيار ، واستروح قلبه عن ترجم الأفكار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God’s gift of children to Abraham in old age is a favor approaching the rank of a miracle, for which Abraham gives thanks.
rows.anchor: ويلتحق ذلك بوجه من المعجزات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Because Abraham’s praise follows his request, it can be read as seeking another blessing through gratitude for the first: as God gave a child in old age, grant the other requests.
rows.anchor: فكأنه قال : كما أكرمتني بهبة الولد على الكبر ؛ فأكرمني بهذه الأشياء

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: Another allusion asks that, having bestowed children in old age, God complete the blessing by keeping Abraham and his offspring from idolatry.
rows.anchor: ويقال الإشارة في هذا أنه قال : كما مننت علي فوهبتني على الكبر هذه الأولاد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abraham’s statement that his Lord hears prayer alludes to the preceding requests.
rows.anchor: وفي قوله : { إن ربى لسميع الدعاء } [ إبراهيم : 39 ]

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ‘Make me one who establishes prayer’ implies that human acts are created: making prayer for him means creating prayer for him.
rows.anchor: إشارة إلى أن أفعال العباد مخلوقة ، فمعناه اجعل صلاتي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abraham asks God to make some of his descendants people who pray.
rows.anchor: أي اجعل منهم قوما يصلون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The qualification that some descendants pray is consistent with the statement that God’s covenant does not reach wrongdoers.
rows.anchor: لأنه أخبره في موضع آخر بقوله : لا ينال عهدي الظالمين

rows.speaker: وقيل
rows.claim: One view says Abraham made his prayer for his parents before learning that his father would not believe.
rows.anchor: وهذا قيل أن يعلم أنه لا يؤمن

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: An answered prayer is God’s initiating grace, so a servant should not rely on anyone else’s prayer, however eminent that person may be.
rows.anchor: ويقال إن إجابة الدعاء ابتداء فضل منه ولا ينبغي للعبد أن يتكل على دعاء أحد

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: Abraham’s supplication was exceptionally complete and his concern for his father exemplary, yet his father was not helped and God did not intercede for him.
rows.anchor: فلا دعاء أتم من دعاء إبراهيم عليه السلام ، ولا عناية أتم من عنايته بشأن أبيه

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: A servant must not stop praying or despair of an answer: Abraham continued supplicating for his parents even when his prayer for his father was not answered.
rows.anchor: ويقال لا ينبغي للعبد أن يترك دعاءه أو يقطع رجاءه في ألا يستجيب الله دعاءه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A servant is neither shamed nor humiliated when God does not answer a request: supplication is the servant’s worship, while an answer is divine grace that God may give or withhold.
rows.anchor: فلا غضاضة على العبد ولا تناله مذلة إن لم يجبه مولاه في شيء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The warning that God is not heedless of wrongdoers threatens oppressors and consoles the oppressed; awareness that God knows their affliction makes it easier to bear.
rows.anchor: هذا وعيد للظالمين وتسلية للمظومين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Wronging oneself consists of putting a lapse in place of obedience.
rows.anchor: والظلم على وجوه ؛ ظلم على النفس بوضع الزلة مكان الطاعة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Wronging the heart means allowing blameworthy thoughts to take hold in it.
rows.anchor: وظلم على القلب بتمكين الخواطر الردية منه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Wronging the spirit means directing it toward love of created beings.
rows.anchor: وظلم على الروح بجعلها لمحبة المخلوقين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Satan is among the oppressors: God will vindicate the believer against him unless the believer follows him, and the believer should resist through spiritual struggle and rejection of whispers.
rows.anchor: فالعبد المؤمن مطلوم من جهته ، والحق - سبحانه - ينتصف له منه غدا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ordinary believers attach their hearts to God’s future punishment of oppressors.
rows.anchor: وهذا للعوام من المؤمنين ، علق قلوبهم بالانتقام منهم في المستأنف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The elect forgive their oppressors and are content that God knows their condition.
rows.anchor: وأما الخواص فإذ علموا أنه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The elect among the elect seek not only pardon for themselves but forgiveness for those who wronged them, as in the Prophet’s prayer for his people.
rows.anchor: وأما خواص الخواص فإذ علموا أنهم عبيده فإنهم لا يرضون بالعفو عن ظلمهم

rows.speaker: النبي
rows.claim: The Prophet prayed, ‘O God, forgive my people, for they do not know.’
rows.anchor: كما قال النبي - - : ( اللهم اغفر لقومي فإنهم لا يعلمون )

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People of tawhid see God as the sole originator, so they do not reckon with, reproach, or demand from another; affirming another as independently existent is, to them, shirk.
rows.anchor: فإذا علموا أنه المنشئ ، وألا مخترع سواه فليس بينهم وبين أحد محاسبة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The wrongdoers spoiled their earlier affairs and fell short of their obligations; no later repair or excuse can undo this, so the criminal is exposed and judgment falls.
rows.anchor: أفسدوا في أول أمورهم ، وقصروا في الواجب عليهم ، ولم يكن للخلل في أحوالهم جبران

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God addresses later hearers: earlier offenders were punished as a lesson, but you imitated them and were deluded by the respite, so expect the recompense for your own deeds.
rows.anchor: وأشهدناكم ذلك مما اعتبرتم ، وجريتم على منهاجهم ، وفعلتم مثل فعلهم

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: Keeping company with or living near people of passion and sin counts as sharing in their actions, and leads to the same ruin.
rows.anchor: ويقال إن معاشرة أهل الهوى والفسق ومجاورتهم مشاركة لهم في فعلهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God does not fail the messengers’ promise; truthful in speech, He may punish as He wills within His dominion, and neither a friend escapes His might nor anyone His retribution.
rows.anchor: أي لا تحسبنه يخلف رسله وعده ؛ لأنه لا يخلف الوعد لصدقه في قوله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When the earth and sky change, their underlying identities remain; it is their forms, times, and places that change for people as their conditions shift.
rows.anchor: لا يختلف عينها وإنما تختلف صورتها ، وكذلك إذا انكدرت النجوم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People moving from ease to hardship, or hardship to ease, speak as if time itself has changed, though the change is in their circumstances.
rows.anchor: كمن صار من الرخاء إلى البلاء يقول : تغير الزمان والوقت

rows.speaker: آدم
rows.claim: The account says Adam lamented the changed state of the lands and their people after one son killed the other.
rows.anchor: ويقال إن آدم لما قتل أحد ابنيه الآخر قال : تغيرت البلاد ومن عليها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A person once in spiritual expansion may be reduced to contraction, or intimacy to veiling, and experience this as the earth having changed.
rows.anchor: وفي هذه القصة من كان صاحب بسط فرد

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: A poem laments that people and places are no longer as the speaker once knew them.
rows.anchor: قال بعضهم : ما الناس بالناس الذي عهدي بهم . . . ولا البلاد بتلك التي كنت أعرفها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: For a seeker in a spiritual pause or lapse, the sun seems exposing, the earth trembles, day becomes night, and night becomes ruin.
rows.anchor: وكذلك العبد المريد إذا وقعت له وقفة أو فترة كانت الشمس له كاشفة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A poem portrays the world as no longer easy, the dawn as joyless, and the water of life as no longer cool.
rows.anchor: وكما قيل : فما كانت الدنيا بسهل ولا الضحا . . . بطلق ولا ماء الحياة ببارد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Fetters gather and bind the condemned; pitch clothes them, boiling water is their drink, and fire surrounds them as punishment for disobeying God.
rows.anchor: الأصفاد الأغلال . الأصفاد تجمعهم ، والسلاسل تقيدهم ، والقطران سرابيلهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The proofs, signs, calls, respite, messenger, and ability to fulfill obligation were all available, yet prior divine allotment withheld success; the reflective are saved and the heedless fall.
rows.anchor: الحجج ظاهرة ، والأمارات لائحة ، والدواعي واضحة ، والمهلة متسعة

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: What people possess of their gnoses and beloved things consists of successive traces and alternating kinds: their entities pass away, although their effects remain.
rows.anchor: ويقال ما منكم من معارفكم ومحابكم آثار متعاقبة ، وأصناف متناوبة

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: God’s mercy, love, and constancy toward people are eternal attributes and everlasting qualities.
rows.anchor: وثباته عليكم فصفات أزلية ونعوت سرمدية

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: Another reading says people’s longing to meet God may vanish, while His own welcome and favor toward them never end.
rows.anchor: ويقال ما عندكم من اشتياقكم إلى لقائنا فمعرض للزوال ، وقابل للانقضاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A verse of poetry says that the righteous long greatly to meet God, while God longs even more to meet them.
rows.anchor: كما قيل : ألا طال شوق الأبرار إلى لقائي . . . وإني للقائهم لأشد شوقا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The reward of patience is attaining one’s desired object, though the outcomes of different kinds of patience vary.
rows.anchor: جزاء الصبر الفوز بالطلبة ، والظفر بالبغية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who patiently endure hardship in God’s cause receive immense recompense, as promised in 39:10.
rows.anchor: فمن صبر على مقاساة مشقة في الله . فعوضه وثوابه عظيم من قبل الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who restrain desire and avoid a lapse for God’s sake receive the chamber as their reward, as stated in 25:75.
rows.anchor: ومن صبر عن اتباع شهوة لأجل الله ، وعن ارتكاب هفوة مخافة لله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who remain patient under God’s decree, certain they are under His regard, are met by God’s companionship, as in 2:153.
rows.anchor: ومن صبر تحت جريان حكم الله ، متحققا بأنه بمرآة من الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A righteous deed is one fit for acceptance, and what is acceptable is what accords with God’s command.
rows.anchor: الصالح ما يصلح للقبول ، والذي يصلح للقبول ما كان علىلوجه الذي أمر الله به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Righteous action belongs to the present and good life to the future: purity in one’s present condition secures fulfillment in the outcome.
rows.anchor: في المآل ؛ فصفاء الحال يستوجب وفاء المآل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A righteous deed cannot exist without faith, which is why the verse adds ‘while believing.’
rows.anchor: والعمل الصالح لا يكون من غير إيمان ، ولذا قال : { وهو مؤمن }

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: One interpretation says the believer knows his faith comes from God’s grace, not from his righteous deed.
rows.anchor: ويقال { وهو مؤمن } أي مصدق بأن إيمانه من فضل الله لا بعمله الصالح

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: Another interpretation says the believer knows his deed occurs through God’s enabling, creation, and origination.
rows.anchor: ويقال { وهو مؤمن } أي مصدق بأن عمله بتوفيق الله وإنشائه وإبدائه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The ‘then’ marks immediate succession for the good life, whereas the conjunction before the reward signals its later arrival.
rows.anchor: الفاء للتعقيب ، { ولنجزينهم . . . } الواو للعطف ففي الأولى معجل ، وفي الثانية مؤجل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A good life is known by spiritual taste rather than verbal definition; reported meanings include sweetness of obedience, contentment, satisfaction, intimate communion, and the breeze of nearness, all true for different people.
rows.anchor: ثم ما تلك الحياة الطيبة فإنه لا يعرف بالنطق ، وإنما يعرف ذلك بالذوق

rows.speaker: قوم
rows.claim: One group identifies the good life as the sweetness of obedience.
rows.anchor: فقوم قالوا إنه حلاوة الطاعة ، وقوم قالوا إنه القناعة

rows.speaker: قوم
rows.claim: Other groups identify it as contentment, satisfaction, intimate communion, or the breeze of nearness.
rows.anchor: وقوم قالوا إنه القناعة ، وقوم قالوا إنه الرضا ، وقوم قالوا إنه النجوى

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: Another reading defines the good life as being with the beloved.
rows.anchor: ويقال الحياة الطيبة مايكون مع المحبوب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Poetry says joy is incomplete when the beloveds are absent while the lovers remain present.
rows.anchor: نحن في أكمل السرور ولكن . . . ليس إلا بكم يتم السرور

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: For God’s friends, the good life is having no need, supplication, desire, or demand; those whose will is lifted remain servants, while those with no will are freed by spiritual liberty.
rows.anchor: ويقال الحياة الطيبة للأولياء ألا تكون لهم حاجة ولا سؤال ولا أرب ولا مطالبة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Each person’s devil is whatever distracts him from God; even the self can do so by making one dwell on obedience, worship’s sweetness, or one’s spiritual state.
rows.anchor: شيطان كل واحد ما يشغله عن ربه ، فمن تسلطت عليه نفسه حتى شغلته عن ربه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The servant must seek refuge from the evil of his own self and of every evil being.
rows.anchor: والواجب عليه أن يستعيذ بالله من شر نفسه ، وشر كل ذي شر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Satan has power only over people veiled by heedlessness, assumptions, and ambiguities; God alone creates and originates.
rows.anchor: إنما سلطانه على الذين هم في غطاء غفلتهم ، وستر ظنونهم ومشتبهاتهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People of tawhid see events appearing through God, beginning from Him, and returning to Him.
rows.anchor: فأما أصحاب التوحيد فإنهم يرون الحادثات بالله ظهورها ، ومن الله ابتداؤها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The name ‘the Mighty’ makes one who realizes God’s majesty wholly sincere in servanthood; reaching purity’s radiance makes one leave behind outward traits.
rows.anchor: عزيز من تحقق بجلال عزته تمحض في خلوص عبوديته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Knowing the Mighty raises one’s aspiration until desire for both worlds falls away.
rows.anchor: اسم عزيز من عرفه سمت همته ، وإذا سمت همته سقطت عن الدارين طلبته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Knowing this name removes distress and sweetens the heart; one’s religion is the Lord and one’s paradise is His love.
rows.anchor: اسم من عرفه زال كربه وطاب قلبه ، دينه ربه وجنته حبه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The person marked by servanthood is freed from desire’s slavery and aims’ captivity, no longer seeking or fleeing for the beloved’s sake.
rows.anchor: اسم عزيز من وسمه بعبوديته حرره من رق شهواته ، وأعتقه من أسر مطالبه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The letter Ṭāʾ alludes to the Prophet’s heart turned away from everything other than God, and Hāʾ to its guidance toward God.
rows.anchor: والهاء إشارة إلى اهتداء قلبه إلى الله

rows.speaker: وقيل
rows.claim: Another reading hears an address to step with one’s secret onto the carpet of nearness, with no guidance toward anyone but God.
rows.anchor: وقيل طأ بسرك بساط القربة فأنت لا تهتدي إلى غيرنا

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: Another reading says God has folded from the Prophet’s secret all mention of others and guided him to Himself.
rows.anchor: ويقال طوينا عن سرك ذكر غيرنا ، وهديناك إلينا

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: Two further sayings bless whoever is guided by the Prophet and whoever finds a good life by following him.
rows.anchor: ويقال طوبى لمن اهتدى بك . ويقال طاب عيش من اهتدى بك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Quran’s purpose is not to impose worship as hardship; it opens connection and prepares the ground of nearness.
rows.anchor: أي ليس المقصود من إيجابنا إليك تعبدك ، وإنما هذا استفتاح الوصلة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After the Prophet was told not to covet worldly goods given to others (15:88), he stood in abstinence and worship; the response questions his great toil.
rows.anchor: ويقال إنه لما قال له : { ولا تمدن عينيك إلى ما متعنا به أزواجا منهم }

rows.speaker: النبي
rows.claim: The Prophet explained his worship by asking, ‘Should I not be a grateful servant?’
rows.anchor: وقال : ( أفلا أكون عبدا شكورا )

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Quran gives insight to people of understanding and reminder to people of spiritual arrival: the former gain future relief, the latter immediate intimacy.
rows.anchor: فالقرآن تبصرة لذوي العقول ، تذكرة لذوي الوصول

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Just as earth is a resting place for servants, worshippers’ selves are the ground of obedience and knowers’ hearts the ground of gnosis.
rows.anchor: ونفوس العابدين أرض وقرار لطاعتهم ، وقلوب العارفين قرار لمعارفهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alongside the heavenly throne, the hearts of people of tawhid are a throne on earth and a locus of God’s regard.
rows.anchor: استواء عرشه في السماء معلوم ، وعرشه في الأرض قلوب أهل التوحيد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The heavenly throne is described by God’s establishment upon it, while God’s relation to hearts is described as mastery; the heavenly throne receives creation’s prayers, the heart-throne God’s gaze.
rows.anchor: أما عرش السماء فالرحمن عليه استوى ، وعرش القلوب الرحمن عليه استولى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Everything between the heavens and earth that God brought forth from nonexistence belongs to Him by ownership and creation.
rows.anchor: له ما بين السموات والأرض مما أظهر من العدم ؛ فالكل له إثباتا وخلقا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Because Moses stands on tawhid and divine uniqueness, he should not rely on the staff as a support, source of help, or benefit.
rows.anchor: فإنك بنعت التوحيد ، واقف على بساط التفريد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The first step on the path is to abandon every means and strip away every pursuit, so Moses’ listing of uses for the staff raises a question about reliance on it.
rows.anchor: أول قدم في الطريق ترك كل سبب ، والتنقي عن كل طلب

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: Another reading says that the more Moses detailed the staff’s uses, the more firmly he should trust God enough to cast it aside.
rows.anchor: تفصيلا في انتفاعه بعصاه إلا كان أقوى وأولى بأن يؤمن بإلقائها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Tawhid is stripping away all attachments, and its sign is the loss of every independent attribution; thus Moses was commanded to cast the staff away.
rows.anchor: ويقال التوحيد التجريد ، وعلامة صحته سقوط الإضافات بأسرها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When the staff became a moving serpent, Moses fled; the disclosure of the secret of attachment makes its possessor flee.
rows.anchor: فجعلها الله حية تسعى ، وولى موسى هاربا ولم يعقب

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: The staff’s transformation illustrates the nature of attachment: once its secret is unveiled to a person, he runs from it.
rows.anchor: وقيل له يا موسى هذه صفة العلاقة ؛ إذا كوشف صاحبها بسرها يهرب منها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Overjoyed by God’s speech, Moses answered both the question asked and the question unasked, listing the staff’s benefits.
rows.anchor: ويقال لما باسطه الحق بسماع كلامه أخذته أريحية سماع الخطاب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses lists that the staff keeps him company alone, lights the dark, carries him when tired, helps him tend sheep, and repels enemies.
rows.anchor: وذكر وجوها من الانتفاع ؛ منها أنه قال تؤنسني في حال وحدتي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses says the greatest benefit is that God asked what he held; no blessing or use could exceed being addressed by God.
rows.anchor: وأعظم مأرب لي فيها أنك قلت : { وما تلك بيمينك ؟ }

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: Another reading says the staff had an unlisted benefit: its becoming a serpent was a miracle and proof of Moses’ truthfulness.
rows.anchor: قال الحق - بعد ما عدد موسى وجوه الآيات

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: All the staff’s benefits came from God, so Moses should not attribute them to himself; a poem makes the same point about gifts given to the beloved.
rows.anchor: ويقال جميع ما عدد من المنافع في العصا كان من قبل الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Poetry says that when gifts are given to you, none of them is truly from you.
rows.anchor: يا جنة الخلد ، والهدايا إذا . . . تهدى إليك فما منك يهدى

rows.speaker: موسى
rows.claim: Seeing the staff alive and moving, Moses says he knew all its descriptions except this transformation.
rows.anchor: ويقال قال موسى لها رآها حية تهتز : لقد علمت كل وصف بهذه العصا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Appearances can mislead, since what seems one way may later prove otherwise; Moses’ staff became a serpent.
rows.anchor: لا عبرة بما يوهم ظاهر الأشياء ؛ فقد يوهم الظاهر بشيء ثم يبدو خلافه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The transformation’s purpose was to be a sign and miracle, not a trial or temptation.
rows.anchor: ثم قال المقصود بذلك أن تكون لك آية ومعجزة لا بلاء وفتنة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The staff’s sequence of changes shows that God makes His servants stable through changing states, alternately gathering and separating them.
rows.anchor: مرة عصا ثم ثعبانا ثم عصا مرة أخرى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: As an outward sign in the staff, God also showed Moses an inward sign by making his hand white when he put it in his pocket, without leprosy.
rows.anchor: كما أراه آية من خارج أراه آية من نفسه ، وهي قلب يده بيضاء

rows.speaker: موسى
rows.claim: Moses says he can report only what his Lord has told him: he knows what was made known and stops where God veiled matters from him.
rows.anchor: لا يمكنني أن أخبركم إلا بما أخبرني به ربي فما عرفني عرفت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Earth is a resting place for bodies, bodies a resting place for worship, hearts for gnosis, spirits for love, and inner secrets for witnessing.
rows.anchor: جعل الأرض مستقرا لأبدانهم ، وجعل أبدانهم مستقرا لعبادته ، وقلوبهم مستقرا لمعرفته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God prepared livelihoods, provides for people and the animals they use, and directs them to draw strength from what they can reach and benefit from their livestock.
rows.anchor: هيأ لهم أسباب المعيشة ، وكما نظر إليهم ورزقهم رزق دوابهم التي ينتفعون بها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Since God created Adam from earth and brought people from his loins, they too were created from earth.
rows.anchor: إذ خلقنا آدم من التراب ، وإذ أخرجناكم من صلبه . . . فقد خلقناكم من التراب أيضا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Bodies are forms related to soil, while spirits are entrusted gifts related to nearness; God adorns bodies with grace and revives spirits through unveiling of majesty and beauty.
rows.anchor: والأجشاد قوالب والأرواح ودائع ، والقوالب نسبتها التربة ، والودائع صفتها القربة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Bodies abide in worship and spirits in enduring gnosis.
rows.anchor: وللقوالب اليوم اعتكاف على بساط عبادته ، وللودائع اتصاف بدوام معرفته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Although the warning was given openly, the addressees were blinded inwardly to its significance, so Moses’ warning of punishment and promise of grace did not benefit them.
rows.anchor: وأعماه عن شهود ذلك بسره ، فما نجع فيه كلامه ، وما انتفع بما حذره من انتقامه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses called them to God and spoke of the afterlife’s reward and punishment, but they responded only in worldly terms; reminders increased their heedlessness and ignorance.
rows.anchor: دعاهم موسى إلى الله ، وخاطبهم في حديث الآخرة من تبشير بثواب ، وإنذار بعذاب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One marked by divine exclusion lacks gnosis and faith, regrets nothing missed, and does not believe in what lies ahead.
rows.anchor: كذلك صفة من وسمه الحق بالإبعاد ، لم يكن له عرفان ، ولا بما يقال إيمان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sorcerers’ proposed appointment prepares them to oppose the Real, but divine will crushes and overwhelms them.
rows.anchor: تأهبوا لمناصبة الحقيقة ، وتشمروا للمخالفة ، فقصمتهم المشيئة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Pharaoh plotted and was counter-plotted; his intention rebounded on him, and his call to prepare ended in humiliation and punishment.
rows.anchor: كاد فرعون فكيد له ، وأراد فارتد إليه ، ودعا للاستعداد فأذل وأذيق البأس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses exhausted admonition and gentleness, while Pharaoh displayed every form of folly and stupidity.
rows.anchor: ولم يدع موسى شيئا من الوعظ والرفق ، ولم يغادر فرعون شيئا من البله والحمق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sorcerers dismissed Moses’ warning as a lie and his miracle as magic, claiming that he and Aaron sought to expel them and destroy their exemplary way.
rows.anchor: فحملوا مقالته على الإفك ، ورموا معجزته بالسجر فقالوا

rows.speaker: السحرة
rows.claim: The sorcerers call on one another to unite their scheme and come in rows, claiming that the one who prevails that day will succeed.
rows.anchor: فأجمعوا كيدكم ثم ائتوا صفا وقد أفلح اليوم من استعلى
